name: Movement Detector (Video)
description: Detects moving vs stationary bouts from video using an OpenCV object tracker. User draws a bounding box around the subject in the first frame.

outputs.name: moving_bouts
outputs.description: Intervals where the subject is moving [[start_ms, end_ms], ...]

parameters.name: subject_bbox
parameters.label: Subject (first frame)
parameters.description: Bounding box drawn on the subject in the first frame (x,y,w,h normalised 0-1). Required.

parameters.name: movement_threshold
parameters.label: Movement Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum per-frame centroid displacement (normalised by frame width) to count as movement

parameters.name: smoothing_window_ms
parameters.label: Smoothing Window (ms)
parameters.description: Rolling mean window applied to the displacement signal before thresholding

parameters.name: merge_gap_ms
parameters.label: Merge Gap (ms)
parameters.description: Merge moving bouts separated by less than this gap
